findings.concern: source-name equality could be represented as an FFI link
findings.resolution: the data model emits only declaration/export candidates and carries an explicit no-linkage scope; no call or graph table is written.

findings.concern: a Tezos parent-directory scan could mix nested worktrees or an opam switch
findings.resolution: the corpus root is fixed and symlinks, worktrees, vendor/build directories, _opam and .opam-switch are excluded; the self-test covers both worktree and _opam contamination.

findings.concern: a raw count could be read as linked targets or graph precision
findings.resolution: the research record calls the 2,326 entries an observation only and requires Stage 2 target/artifact attribution before a link metric exists.

accepted_limits: Source-level patterns can miss generated bindings and cannot establish ABI, target or linkage.
Vendored and historical material within the selected root remains inventory scope until Stage 2 build attribution.
